text:
emily.porter: Quick heads-up — we're shifting the release train cadence from weekly -> biweekly starting next cycle to give QA more soak time. Release freeze will be 48h before cutover on Apr 8. Leave rollback windows unchanged. Please read the rollout checklist and flag exceptions by EOD Wed. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

anish.kumar: Is the freeze global for hosted + dedicated? We have a Dedicated customer cutover that week.

emily.porter: Freeze applies to hosted and dedicated control plane changes. Customer infra cutover (dedicated capacity) can still be scheduled with SRE approval — ping @eng-sre with the CR and impact.

james.ng: For canary targets, are we prioritizing latency-sensitive models first? Some traffic routing changes might affect them.

emily.porter: Yes prioritize latency-sensitive routes. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 2h windows, monitor p95 latency + error rate. If either crosses thresholds rollback immediately. Doc: https://redwood/docs/release/cadence-change

release-bot: Canary rollout started on canary-group-3 at 1918002234

maya: Small ask — can we allow one-time freeze exception for a quant plugin deprecation patch? It's tiny and fixes a noisy warning that affects metrics

anish.kumar: We'll need test results and eval that shows no regression on perplexity/accuracy. Upload to the release checklist under 'artifacts' and @eng-sre will review.

eng-sre: Confirmed. Submit CR to #release-war-room and tag us. We'll try to review within 4h during business hours. Non-blocking if it's infra only.

emily.porter: Exception process: create PR labeled release-exception, include test matrix, perf numbers, and a remediation plan. Triage meeting Thurs 10:00 PT for any outstanding exceptions.

james.ng: Rolling back a canary — what's the command? I only know the old one.

emily.porter: Use the new CLI `redwoodctl rollback --route <route> --canary-group <id>` — example:
``
redwoodctl rollback --route=chat-gen --canary-group=3 --reason="p95 spike"
```

release-bot: Canary at 25% complete; no alerts detected.

maya: Noted. I'll attach the perf artifacts by EOD.

emily.porter: Thanks. Reminder: no major schema migrations during freeze window without explicit approval. Any questions ping me or @james.ng. :thumbsup:
